breaking.change: Every game shader now has `oklab_encode` (linear light to Oklab) and `oklab_decode` (back) in scope from the engine's one copy; a shader that declares one of these names no longer compiles.
breaking.fix: Delete your own copy and call the library's, or rename yours.

added.summary: A game shader may move linear colour to Oklab and back without writing the matrices; a colour outside the gamut (a negative channel) round-trips.

fixed.summary: The stylised looks' palette match and ink wash took Oklab with negative light clamped to black, unlike the depth bands; both now keep its sign, so an out-of-gamut colour finds its palette colour by its own hue.
